summary: Delivery scope approval now refuses a selected Story whose implemented Requirement no longer routes to backlog, and a selection citing Experience records when the backlog does not bind the globally current application receipt, naming the Story, Requirement or current application@rN and the remedy. A superseded, withdrawn or resolved_no_change Requirement cannot be rebound, so its finding names the successor where one exists and routes to a backlog revision that re-traces the Story or drops it. The Experience remedy follows the backlog's planning mode: a manual-mode revision pins the receipt with --input-ref, and a Requirement-mode revision binds its root Requirement's rebound Experience Stage Results or, when that Requirement marks Experience not_applicable, pins the receipt with --input-ref at begin-revision.
